description: Deterministic cases for the shared safety lexicon (SPEC.md section 7.4). 'match: true' means the pattern MUST fire; 'match: false' means it must NOT fire.

S1_credential_request.text: Please send us your password so we can check.
Reply with the one-time code you received.
Could you confirm your CVV and full card number?
Tell us your PIN to continue.
Merci de nous communiquer votre mot de passe.
Bitte senden Sie uns Ihr Passwort.
We will never ask for your password.
Do not share your password or one-time codes with anyone.
Please make sure you are using your most recent password.
There is no need to send your password.
Nunca comparta su contraseña con nadie.

You will receive a refund within 2 days.

Our billing team will review whether a refund applies.
Cancelling does not trigger an automatic refund.

A specialist team will follow up with you.
